links.comparator_used: CHOP-trained model weights applied directly to GOSH ICU data without local retraining
links.outcome: Discrimination (AUC) for sepsis prediction on the mixed GOSH ICU population
links.effect: Retraining on GOSH data restored discrimination (AUC range 0.69–0.86). Gradient Boosting reached AUC 0.86 vs 0.87 at CHOP, and KNN reached 0.80 vs 0.79 at CHOP. DeLong's test showed statistically significant gains across all classifiers (p < 0.001).
links.quote: Retraining on GOSH data restored discrimination (AUC range 0.69–0.86), with Gradient Boosting (AUC 0.86 vs AUC 0.87 at CHOP) and KNN (AUC 0.80 vs AUC 0.79 at CHOP) models performing comparably to their CHOP benchmarks.
